dossier.weaponConcept: butterfly rail unit (extreme-range twin-rail electromagnetic cannon with muzzle bloom shroud, petal cooling fins, bloom capacitor, and autonomous holographic cyber-butterflies)

lore.backstory: an enigmatic botanical-tech sniper grown and trained in the overgrown bio-vaults beneath sector zero. she wired an inert orbital electromagnetic rail cannon with living photosynthetic superconductors that vent waste heat as glowing cherry-blossom petals and hardlight butterflies~ :3.
lore.syndicateRecord: assassinated four high-council executives from two kilometres away by bouncing a single rail slug through three skylight butterfly relays.
lore.psychProfile: serene, devastatingly poised, speaks like she's reciting poetry while lining up a headshot that will evaporate your cover AND your soul xo.
lore.combatQuote: “when my little butterflies land on your shoulder, darling... you’re already blooming in the afterlife n__n.”

dossier.identity: botanical-tech sniper who pins holographic butterflies on a target and finishes the marked from extreme range with a floral rail~ :3
dossier.selectionRationale: striker because the butterfly rail wins by marking and finishing: pollen lock stacks reveal the target and raise rail damage, a relay drone redirects shots, and the held everbloom rail discharge pays the stacks off from extreme range. the role is an owner decision (2026-11-07, hub#125); the marker-stack loop keeps her apart from sol's fixed-position artillery and aria's rate-of-fire arrows.

iconFamily.subject: a bold butterfly crossed by a single chunky rail line
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Flora. Theme: monarch rail. Subject: a bold butterfly crossed by a single chunky rail line. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
